purpose: Pre-load resident-idle AP trace as an observed initial condition; predict later short CG_DC and recovery without post-load AP input
one_shot_study_start_ap: fresh finite HAL AP below 32.5 C in both sessions; study stratum, not a device safety threshold; no temperature waiting or extra warming
development_role: one pulse after 35 s release shift; technical identifiability and post-hoc method development, not independent accuracy
confirmation_role: two separated half-pulses after 35 s and 60 s release shifts; same method frozen before this session
